title: 10% off most rail fares for travelers 65+
availability: Most Amtrak trains in the U.S.
summary: Travelers age 65+ can receive 10% off most rail fares on most Amtrak trains. Valid proof of age is required; exclusions apply.
terms: Does not apply to sleeping accommodation charges and may not combine with other offers. Cross-border service uses a different age threshold.

title: 10% senior discount for shoppers 55+
availability: U.S. stores and eligible online purchases
summary: Shoppers age 55+ can receive 10% off eligible purchases after verification through Michaels Rewards or by showing valid ID in store.
terms: Exclusions and daily or product limits apply. Check the merchant page for the current exclusion list.

title: 15% off qualifying in-store purchases on Wednesdays for 60+
summary: Customers age 60+ can receive 15% off qualifying in-store purchases every Wednesday. Bring identification to verify age.
terms: In-store only. Coupon exclusions apply and the offer cannot be combined with other percent-off coupons.

title: Reduced senior prices on selected sailings for travelers 55+
summary: Royal Caribbean states that reduced senior prices are available on selected sailings for guests age 55+.
terms: At least one guest per stateroom must qualify. Availability and pricing vary by sailing and may change.

title: Senior rates for eligible guests 62+ at participating hotels
summary: Guests age 62+ can access Marriott senior rates at participating properties, subject to availability and hotel-specific pricing.
terms: Valid proof of age may be required at check-in. Participating hotels, rates and availability vary.

title: Special-value 55+ menu at participating IHOP restaurants
summary: IHOP lists a 55+ menu with specially priced all-day favorites. Menu items and prices vary by restaurant.
terms: Select your restaurant location and confirm the current local menu and pricing before visiting.
